version: confirmatory re-test M1: frozen plan-v4 round-5 selected controllers, fresh blind set, manoeuvre-focused rule
written_before: the fresh blind set is generated and before any learned controller is run on it
decided_by: the user (2026-10-19 JST): evaluate the learned layer on the manoeuvres it controls; hover/upset as non-inferiority; use the round-5 controllers
rationale: the gated learned layer acts only during nod/dash commands; hover and upset are flown by the classical layer (1.000 and 1.050 by construction), so the plan-v4 four-task composite mixes two constants into the learned layer score. This rule was formulated after six rounds; the paper reports it as a post-hoc reformulation tested once on fresh data, alongside every plan-v4 pre-registered verdict.
frozen: no retraining, no re-selection; the five round-5 selections (128-case rule) as archived in plan_v4/r5/claude_ea/reselect_r5_s*.json

test_set.nod_dash: fresh maneuver_v2 base 2_096_900_000 (never used: earlier bases 2_096_100/400/500/600/700/800_000; training < 2_096_310_000)
test_set.normalisers: nod/dash: classical schedule per-case median on the fresh set (claude-ea); hover/upset: opponent mean (unchanged)

rule.per_seed: (nod + dash)/2 <= 0.95 AND hover <= 1.06 AND upset <= 1.06 AND 0 crashes in the 32 nod+dash blind episodes (all strict, unrounded)
rule.secondary: per-task ratios, paired wins vs the classical opponent, the plan-v4 four-task composite for each seed
